# GET /api/v1/settings/attachment

Returns instance's global attachment settings including allowed types, max size, and max files

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-018`

## Response

**200** — GeneralAttachmentSettings

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `enabled` | bool | Whether file attachments are enabled |
| `allowed_types` | string | Comma-separated list of allowed file types |
| `max_size` | int64 | Maximum size for individual attachments in MB |
| `max_files` | int | Maximum number of files per attachment |
